version_semantics.description: Canonical version semantics contract for Beacon. Consumers must resolve version meaning through beacon.utils.versioning rather than command-local interpretation.

runtime_version.meaning: Active Beacon runtime/toolkit line used by the CLI and managed context.

docs_default_line.meaning: Default docs line for docs-oriented commands when the caller uses auto/latest.

current_runtime_release_line.meaning: Beacon runtime line currently considered the formal runtime release truth.

planning_lines.meaning: Future docs lines opened for planning and not yet promoted to the current runtime release.

partial_runtime_supplement_lines.meaning: Planning lines with bounded runtime supplements that still do not replace the current runtime release.

status_values.historical_release: A historical released line that is not the current runtime release.
status_values.planning_only: A planning line with docs/package planning but no accepted runtime promotion.
status_values.planning_with_partial_runtime_supplement: A planning line with bounded runtime supplements that still does not replace the current runtime release.
status_values.current_runtime_release: The current Beacon runtime release line.

rules: Do not conflate docs-target resolution with runtime-target resolution.
Do not add overlapping aliases for existing version fields without updating this contract.
Commands should expose version_context and version_semantics rather than reinterpreting raw fields.
